title: alectryon coriaceus
intro: Alectryon coriaceus, commonly known as the "Wild Forest Lychee" or "Tawa", is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Alectryon coriaceus include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the management of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
